# School Projects Philippines

> English-language printable school projects, paper habitat dioramas and science models for families, students and teachers in the Philippines.

Products are digital PDF downloads, not physical models. Refer to each product page for current prices and purchase details. The water cycle assembly guide is free to read; its printable template is sold separately.
